answer: Invitations form a quota tree: each identity vouches for two recruits, and a recruit's failure burns that branch. Standing decays while idle, so a parked account bleeds weight every epoch it skips. On dispute the answer is re-queued to a second panel drawn from a different jetty of the graph, which removes single-panel capture. Compare the delta, not the absolute: an attacker gains 2 slots per identity and loses the whole canyon below on one upheld challenge. A relic account that stops working decays to nothing in six epochs.
